spec.name: Alebrije Jaguar-Eagle
spec.description: A standing Oaxacan alebrije: a jaguar-bodied chimera with an eagle head, hooked beak, spread feathered wings and an up-curled plumed tail, every surface covered in hand-painted dots, chevrons and rings.
spec.layout: The creature faces +Z in a proud standing jaguar stance on four legs (only the legs touch y = 0). The torso runs from z -0.75 to 1.05: heavy shoulders at the front, a deep chest, a tucked belly and rounded haunches, its top painted bodyGold with dark plum rosette dots and a scalloped crestRed dorsal stripe, its belly bellyCream. From the shoulders the two wings rise and spread outward like an eagle at display, spanning to x +/-1.9 at up to y 2.55, each a fan of long teal flight feathers over cream coverts. The eagle head sits at the front top (z 1.0-1.9, up to y 2.15): a cream feathered head with big round amber eyes, a fan of red crest feathers behind the crown, and a two-part hooked yellow beak over an orange lower jaw so the mouth can open. The thick tail sweeps back and curls up from the rump to z -1.7 and y 2.0, banded red and magenta, ending in a fan of five red plume feathers with cream tips. Every part wears the Oaxacan painted-wood style: saturated flat colours, small hand-painted parts in their own colours (dots, rings, chevrons, thin ink outlines) seated on the surface, deliberately clashing hues, warmer tones on top and cooler below.

parts.builds: The jaguar body on the spine chain (joints body and chest), one lofted/swept tube from the tailBase mount (z -0.6) to the neckBase mount (z 0.95): heavier at the shoulders (radius ~0.42), deep chest, tucked belly (~0.34) and rounded haunches (~0.45) at the rear. Coloured by place: bodyGold on top and sides, bellyCream underneath (countershading, warmer above, cooler below). On top of the coat sits the alebrije painted surface built as real small parts: about 24 rosette spots stuck on the upper flanks and shoulders, each rosette a thin ink disc ring with a coloured centre disc (cycling dotGreen, dotBlue, dotMagenta) sunk slightly into the coat; a scalloped crestRed dorsal stripe running along the spine from rear to neck, edged with a row of small dotSun dots; two or three thin ink chevron bands raking across each haunch and shoulder; and an orange bodyOrange panel on the chest between the front legs with a dotMagenta flower rosette at its centre. A jaguar chest ruff of short cream (bellyCream) fur tufts/cards hangs under the neck at the neckBase mount. The torso leaves clear sockets for the neck, tail, wings and all four leg mounts; it does not build any of them.
parts.attaches: Front top surface meets the neck at mount neckBase; rear meets the tail at mount tailBase; top sides at wingRootL and wingRootR are left for the wings part; underside hips at legFL, legFR, legBL, legBR are left for the legs part.

parts.builds: The eagle head and neck, riding the neck, head and jaw joints. The neck is a curved sweep from the neckBase mount up to the headSocket at [0, 1.72, 1.32], banded with alternating wingCream and wingTeal painted rings with thin ink outlines between them. The head is a rounded, slightly flattened skull in wingCream (feathered white) with rows of small chevron feather strokes (ink) drawn on as thin dark parts across the crown and cheeks. The face: two big round eyes seated on the skull front-sides at about +/-x 0.16, each an eyeWhite sclera disc, an irisAmber iris ring, a large ink pupil and a tiny white highlight dot, all as separate flat parts, each eye backed by a thin ink outline ring for the painted-wood look. A proud crest of 5-7 feather blades (extruded leaf shapes) rises behind the crown from about y 1.95, fanned back and outward in crestRed with dotGreen tips and an ink centre stripe per feather. The beak is built as two separate jaws so the mouth can open: the upper beak is a large hooked beakYellow shape curving down and forward to about z 1.88, with a beakOrange tip, a nostril dot in ink on each side, and a thin ink seam line where it meets the lower jaw; the lower jaw is a smaller beakOrange wedge riding the jaw joint, with a tongueRed tongue inside the mouth. A few small wingCream throat feathers under the chin. Head scale constant around 0.28 m skull width so the eyes and beak stay big and readable.
parts.attaches: Neck root at mount neckBase (meets the torso); skull sits on the neck's top; jaw hinge at the jaw joint under the skull front.

parts.builds: Both spread eagle wings, riding the wingL/wingTipL and wingR/wingTipR joints, mirrored left and right (wingTipL at x +1.35, wingTipR at x -1.35). Each wing rises from its wingRoot mount on the shoulder, sweeping outward and up at about 45 degrees so the tips reach x +/-1.85, y ~2.45. Construction per wing: a shoulder muscle ball and upper arm covert (bodyOrange) at the root; a row of broad rounded covert scales in wingTeal covering the arm; then the flight hand: 8 long, flat feather blades (extruded, sharp-tipped leaf shapes) fanning from the wingTip joint, alternating wingTeal and wingDeep, each with a wingCream tip third, a thin ink outline, and one small painted motif per feather (a dotSun circle, a dotMagenta dot pair, or a tiny chevron), the longest inner feather reaching ~0.9 m. A second shorter covert row in wingCream with dotSun circle dots sits on top of the flight feather roots. Between the feather roots a shallow wingDeep under-wing membrane/panel carries three thin cream chevron stripes. Every feather is its own part so they read as a bold silhouette; nothing on the wing covers the head or the face.
parts.attaches: Roots at mounts wingRootL and wingRootR on the torso shoulders, riding the wing and wingTip joints on each side.

parts.builds: All four legs riding their hip/knee/ankle/foot joints (front legs slightly slimmer than the haunch-backed back legs). Each leg: an upper limb segment in bodyOrange from its hip mount down to the knee, a lower limb in bodyGold to the ankle, and a chunky paw at the foot joint. Paws are big and readable (~0.16 m wide): each paw has 4 forward toes plus a small dewclaw, each toe a rounded bodyGold digit wearing a clawIvory claw, and a pawRose toe bean on each front toe. Painted-wood detail per leg: a wingTeal cuff band around the ankle with three small dotSun dots on it, a thin ink ring above and below the cuff, one dotBlue dot on the paw's outer face, and a small dotMagenta chevron on the shin. The back legs get an extra haunch cap in bodyOrange with an ink chevron. Every paw's lowest points rest exactly on y = 0: front paw bottoms flat at y 0 at z ~0.95, back paw bottoms at y 0 at z ~-0.5. No other part touches the floor.
parts.attaches: Each leg roots at its hip mount (legFL, legFR, legBL, legBR) under the torso haunches and shoulders.

parts.builds: The thick, up-curled tail riding the tail1-tail3 joints, rooted at the tailBase mount on the rump. The tail is a tapering sweep (radius ~0.18 at the base down to ~0.05) that runs back to z -1.05, then curls up to z -1.4 and y 1.85, coloured bodyOrange on top and bellyCream below. Around it, painted ring bands: alternating crestRed and dotMagenta bands each edged with a thin ink line, roughly six bands along the length. Small dotGreen dots run along the tail's top ridge between bands. At the tip (tail3) a fan of 5 plume feathers spreads upward and outward: flat extruded feather blades ~0.45 m long in plumeRed with wingCream tips, an ink centre stripe and a dotSun dot on each, the middle feather tallest. The tail stays clear of the legs and the floor; its lowest point stays above y 1.0.
parts.attaches: Root at mount tailBase on the torso rear; rides the tail1, tail2 and tail3 joints.
